messages.subject: Meridian - completion arrangements & funds
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya,

We're set for completion on Monday 19 January. The completion statement shows the balance due from the buyer at £13,176,548.61 after deducting the deposit, the £75k retention, the £84k Unit 6 rent deposit, and the apportionments. Pennine are advancing £8.55m, so the equity required from you is £4,626,548.61. Please arrange those cleared funds to our client account by 9am Monday.

Full breakdown to follow in the completion statement.

James

--
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0820
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
